quick_wits.name: Quick Wits
quick_wits.description: Once per combat, discard a card to draw a card. Costs no play or Time.

measured_breath.name: Measured Breath
measured_breath.description: End an activation with an unused play to bank it for your next activation. One banked play maximum.

ghost_stride.name: Ghost Stride
ghost_stride.description: Once per combat, a card used to Move may Blink 2 instead.

discerning_eye.name: Discerning Eye
discerning_eye.description: Once per sequence, replace all cards in a combat reward.

rehearsed_escape.name: Rehearsed Escape
rehearsed_escape.description: Once per combat, arm before playing a non-item Burn card; that card goes to discard instead.

makeshift_tool.name: Makeshift Tool
makeshift_tool.description: Once per combat, arm before using an item as a basic Attack or Move; it goes to discard instead of being consumed.

carry_the_guard.name: Carry the Guard
carry_the_guard.description: Once per combat, block left at the end of your activation becomes stoneskin.

pain_remembers.name: Pain Remembers
pain_remembers.description: After you first lose health each combat, the next non-item card you discard returns to your hand.

sure_footed.name: Sure-Footed
sure_footed.description: Once per combat, the first trap blast that would hit you still affects enemies and terrain but leaves you unharmed.

afterimage.name: Afterimage
afterimage.description: Your first Blink each combat leaves a 2-health illusion at the tile you left. You may move through your illusions; ending movement on one dispels it.

deferred_choice.name: Deferred Choice
deferred_choice.description: Skip a card reward to save one offered card. It replaces one card in your next reward.

salvager.name: Salvager
salvager.description: Once per sequence, recover the first equipment reward you leave behind.

borrowed_time.name: Borrowed Time
borrowed_time.description: The first card played with a banked play each combat adds no Time.

last_reserve.name: Last Reserve
last_reserve.description: The first Fatigue draw that would defeat you each combat leaves you at 1 health.

plunderers_step.name: Plunderer's Step
plunderers_step.description: The first Move or Blink that collects loot each combat refunds its play.

prismatic_instinct.name: Prismatic Instinct
prismatic_instinct.description: Once per combat, name a conditional card in hand. The next printed play of any copy satisfies its elemental intensity conditions; basic uses do not consume the arm.

curators_patience.name: Curator's Patience
curators_patience.description: After choosing a relic, save one unchosen relic for the next offer.

living_shadow.name: Living Shadow
living_shadow.description: Once per turn, when an illusion falls, return your latest non-item discard to hand. If your hand is full, put it atop your draw pile.

true_bearing.name: True Bearing
true_bearing.description: Before combat, choose a safe starting tile within 2 spaces of the entrance.

layaway.name: Layaway
layaway.description: Once per sequence, hold one merchant offer for that merchant's next visit. You cannot hold another until it returns.

encore.name: Encore
encore.description: Once per combat, return a non-item discard to your hand. Costs no play or Time.

open_arsenal.name: Open Arsenal
open_arsenal.description: Your trinket slot may hold equipment from any slot.

confluence.name: Confluence
confluence.description: Elemental conditions use your highest intensity, regardless of element. A conditional draw enabled only this way stops before Fatigue.

last_door.name: Last Door
last_door.description: Once per sequence, defeat outside a boss room returns you to the previous room at 1 health. Spent items stay spent.
